entities.summary: Lado Shirinshayevich Davydov, also known simply as Lado Davydov was an Assyrian Soviet soldier during the Second World War. He is most well known for being decorated with Hero of the Soviet Union, and being one of only two Assyrians to have received the medal, alongside Armenian Assyrian Sergey Sarkhoshev.
